newsitem.title: USA: Harris sees double-digit '97 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Harris sees double-digit '97 earnings growth.

text.p: Harris Corp said on Friday that it expects double-digit earnings growth and good revenue growth in fiscal 1997.
The company said its semiconductor unit is still hurt by a weak market, but that its other businesses have excellent growth.

"Given a continuation of the overall economic and market trends, we expect to have another year of double-digit earnings growth in fiscal 1997, coupled with good growth in revenues," stated company Chief Executive Phillip Farmer.
Earlier this week the company reported first quarter profits of $0.98 per share, compared to $0.86 a year ago.
